title: Start as a freelancer
tagline: Business account, e-invoicing, tax reserve, pension and income protection in one go.
trigger: First client invoice paid in, or a stated 'I'm going freelance'.

steps.title: Separate business account
steps.description: A business account and card, so business and private money no longer mix.
steps.why: Opened in the app with your company number.

win.customer: A clean split for your accountant

steps.result: Business PRO account opened. Client payments now land there.

steps.title: E-invoicing over Peppol
steps.description: Send and receive invoices over Peppol, matched automatically with your payments.
steps.why: Accredited Peppol access point, linked to your KBC account. It sees your company, not your bank data.
steps.result: Billit linked: invoices go out over Peppol and payments are matched automatically.

steps.title: Automatic VAT and tax reserve
steps.description: Each paid invoice moves the VAT and an estimate of your income tax into a reserve.
steps.why: KBC sees your incoming invoices, so the reserve calculates itself.
steps.result: Reserve set up: VAT and 25% for income tax from every paid invoice. €{vat_reserve} is already set aside.

steps.title: Your own pension
steps.description: Supplementary pension for the self-employed, tax-deductible.
steps.why: Calculated on your actual income from invoices.

win.customer: Pension gap closed with a tax deduction

steps.result: Supplementary pension started: €150 a month, deductible as a business expense.

steps.title: Income if you fall ill
steps.description: Guaranteed income insurance: as a freelancer, the statutory sickness benefit is small.
steps.why: Covers the gap the statutory system leaves for the self-employed.

win.customer: Income keeps coming when you're ill

steps.result: Guaranteed income insurance active: €2,000 a month after a 30-day waiting period.

steps.title: Professional liability
steps.description: Cover if a client claims damage from your work.
steps.why: Many clients ask for it in the contract.
steps.result: Professional liability insurance active. Certificate saved in your digital vault.
